Every metadata dict now carries scale_is_inferred. The general check is cheaper than the null: trace both sides of an agreement test to their inputs. |
| NLS-3 | the strength-to-scale map records a strong cross-system correlation as 'cellular', so the observation the sensor exists to catch cannot be recorded at all | live | refutation | FALSIFIER | **OUT_OF_SCOPE** — Scale is a property of the EXPERIMENT -- what was sampled, over what extent, across what interval -- and is knowable before the correlation is computed. Correlation strength is a property of the result. Deriving one from the other conflates two quantities with no stated mechanism between them. Passing scale explicitly was already supported and nothing called it that way, so the fix is a caller change, not a model change. |
